method.corpus: 3,000 materialized context rows; each row has 1,536 filler bytes and every 125th row contains the two-token target query.
method.recall_contract: Both strategies must return all 24 target rows before latency is recorded.
method.baseline_scope: The v0.6.24 indexed branch materializes every projection row and filters it in JavaScript. The harness reproduces that indexed algorithm only; filesystem fallback is intentionally excluded from both sides.
